title: IELTS-API: a free, authentication-free, reproducible reference implementation of IELTS scoring and language-assessment analytics
description: IELTS-API is a dependency-free TypeScript library and HTTP API implementing IELTS score arithmetic (including the official Overall Band Score rounding rule), raw-score to band-score conversion for Listening and Reading, the published CEFR alignment, analytic band descriptors, Academic Word List profiling, classical readability indices, an auditable rule base of frequent learner errors, and a transparent glass-box estimator for Writing band scores. Every endpoint is free and requires no authentication, and every response is deterministic so that published results can be reproduced exactly.
